captures.conclusion:
NO_GO · Sign-out security failure

Signing out does not fully end the session in the server test.

The server says sign-out succeeded, but its saved renewal token can still obtain new access. This token is also called a refresh credential.

Someone holding a copied renewal token could regain access after sign-out. That token lets the app renew a session.

Next step: correct the sign-out code or prove this release cannot reach it. Then repeat the test.

P1 · Potential security impact: High. Production exposure remains unverified. Authentication owner not assigned. Code and test evidence. Confidence in the hold: HIGH, 100/100. This is not a release-readiness score.
